moments.action: In an airport arrivals hall Lynn's father pulls her into a hug and she breaks down sobbing on his shoulder; the last shot pulls back wide, the two still clinging together beside her suitcase.
Out of black, a vast empty white hall with Lynn alone on a chair in school uniform. The camera closes to her profile and she is mid-answer, calm, while a clerk types at a desk behind her.

Night party: hands fly up under gold balloons and confetti, Grace beams beside Pat, Pat swigs from a beer bottle, a boy screams along, and the run ends tight on their matching 'STIC 1460' score shirts.
Back in the bare hall, over Lynn's shoulder a figure in black questions her across the table; cut to her face and the composure is gone, her eyes drifting off to the side.
Night at home: her father watches a broadcast from his armchair while Lynn sits on the floor; by the next shot she has moved up onto the sofa, lounging and half-smiling as he talks behind her.

A LINE message from Pat says Bank has already taken his million and her share is waiting. Cut to Lynn staring dead ahead in the empty hall; back on the phone the thread ends with 'Lynn left the chat.'
At the party Pat looks off past the camera, the grin drained out of him; the cut lands on Grace beside him still smiling into the coloured lights, unaware.
